projects.name: CREDEX.IO
projects.subtitle: Measure What You Can Build
projects.description: A credibility scoring experience that turns developer activity into a signal recruiters can understand. Aggregates data from GitHub and coding platforms into an intuitive developer score card.
projects.purpose: Help recruiters evaluate developers beyond traditional resumes by quantifying real coding activity and open-source contributions into a transparent credibility score.
features: Multi-platform credibility scoring system aggregating GitHub and coding platform data
Intuitive score card UI translating raw developer metrics into a recruiter-friendly score
Responsive React.js frontend with clean, modern design

projects.name: The Indian Compass
projects.subtitle: Cultural & Spiritual Guide of India
projects.description: An interactive journey through India's heritage, festivals, cuisines, and artisan stories. Features an integrated AI cultural assistant and interactive maps. This project earned the team the Runner-up position at the Hack Arena 2.0 National Level Hackathon.
projects.purpose: Showcase India's rich cultural diversity through an interactive digital platform with AI-powered features.
features: Responsive, cross-browser frontend showcasing India's heritage, festivals, and cuisines
Integrated AI cultural assistant for visitor questions

projects.name: VectorDB Studio
projects.subtitle: Vector Database and RAG Pipeline
projects.description: A from-scratch vector database implementation in Python featuring multiple search strategies (HNSW, KD-Tree, Brute Force), three distance metrics, a latency benchmark, and a full retrieval-augmented generation pipeline.
projects.purpose: Demonstrate deep understanding of vector database internals and RAG architecture by building both from scratch without relying on managed services.
features: Vector database built from scratch in Python — no managed vector DB dependency
Three search algorithms: HNSW, KD-Tree, and Brute Force
Three distance metrics with latency benchmarking across all strategies
RAG pipeline that chunks documents, generates 768-dimensional embeddings
LLM integration with Gemini API and Ollama for question answering

projects.name: CineMatch
projects.subtitle: Movie Recommendation System
projects.description: A deployed movie recommendation web application combining content-based filtering (TF-IDF similarity) and genre-based recommendations via the TMDB API. Features a clean HTML/CSS/JS frontend backed by a Python REST API.
projects.purpose: Help users discover films they will enjoy using content similarity and genre signals.
features: TF-IDF content similarity model for content-based movie recommendations
TMDB API integration for genre-based recommendations
Full-stack application: HTML/CSS/JS frontend + Python REST API backend
Deployed and publicly accessible on Render
